artworks.title: The Triumph of Galatea
artworks.description: Raphael's sea-chariot — the nymph of Ovid's Sicilian tale, whose mortal lover Acis would become the river beneath Etna after Polyphemus' rage.

artworks.title: Polyphemus
artworks.description: Carracci's Cyclops on the slopes of Etna — the shepherd who loved Galatea and crushed Acis with the mountain's stone.
